notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear Puzzlers,

we've just updated the game to version 1.0.2.

Here's the changelog:

Patch Notes 1.0.2
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that would lead to some undiscovered Point Of Interest Tiles not using their correct visuals.
 Fixed an issue that would prevent the player from increasing their score when a lot of Tiles were explored at the same time.

Improvements

 Improved Rendering Performance.
 Improved Loading Times.

Changes

 Disabled the Exploration Progression Bar tooltip as it caused more confusion than it helped explaining things.

That's it for today, and thank you so so much for your ongoing support and feedback.

Keep it growing!
- the VoodooDucks

notes.title: Growth Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Fellow nature lovers,

first of all thank you for all your feedback you sent along our way, this is very much appreciated! based on that, we prepared a small patch to tackle some issues.

Here's the changelog:

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that would grant the player Point Of Interest Rewards when populating an empty Tile that was not immediately part of a Point Of Interest.
 Fixed an issue that would lead to Reed Tiles having invisible water while being marked as out of range for Animal Population.
 Fixed some Hills and Reed Tiles not playing their spawn animation.
 Fixed some Meadow Tile Rocks always being displayed like they were out of range for the Player.
 Fixed a typo in German localization.

Changes

 Added personal highscore display in Main Menu.
 Added more Controller Input Glyphs to some UI elements.


Thank you so much for your support and keep up populating the world of Growth.

- the Voodoo Ducks

notes.title: Cozy hexagonal-grid soft-strategy puzzle game Growth will release in Summer!
notes.content:
Today, we are happy to announce the cozy puzzle indie game Growth, which premiered exclusively, during the Guerilla Collective showcase. 
More details: https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/guerrilla-collective-mix-2023 

Growth marks the debut of newly founded 2 people strong indie dev VoodooDuck.

With Growth, enjoy a simple, idyllic, and relaxed hexagonal-grid soft-strategy puzzle game, where you will bring life to a world, with terraforming and wildlife.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300300/Growth/ 

Growth will be released in Summer 2023 for PC on Steam and is currently featured in the Guerilla Collective 4 Steam Event!

But that’s not all - To shorten the time to Growth’s release, a free playable demo will be available during Steam Next Fest June 19! Therefore, wishlist the game now, to get notified about the latest news and updates, and when the demo will be released!
 
Watch the Trailer now on YouTube: 
[previewyoutube=51KAx8py1LI;full][/previewyoutube]


About Growth
Growth is a cozy, hexagonal-grid based soft-strategy game. Explore and populate a procedurally generated world by utilizing unique abilities of animals. Growth blends the beauty of cozy exploration with challenging navigation around obstacles such as mountains and rivers to populate fertile soil, transforming barren landscapes into lush forests, meadows and more. Experience an unforgettable mix of discovery and strategy. Start growing your own idyllic landscape!
Explore and expand an ever-growing, procedurally generated map by cleverly connecting clusters of wildlife. Claim newfound clusters or points of interest to receive additional wildlife or in some cases special rewards. As you expand the landscape, you will discover new types of animals, providing unique abilities to overcome obstacles. Whether you're looking for a quick break from work or a relaxed puzzle session, Growths intuitive gameplay lets you explore a beautiful landscape, tile by tile. 

Features of Growth

 Hexagonal-grid-based soft strategy gameplay blends puzzle elements for infinite replayability
 Campaign mode with randomly generated maps puts your problem-solving skills to the test
 Cozy and idyllic gameplay creates a truly relaxing vibe
 Seven different animals with unique abilities to expand your toolset for exploring
 Points of Interest captures are rewarded with new animal types and more
 Nine different tile types allow for beautifully crafted maps and flourishing landscapes

notes.title: Growth is taking part in Earth Appreciation Festival
notes.content:
Growth is taking part in  Earth Appreciation Festival on April 17th, World Earth Day!

The festival is a reminder of the human-made issues that our planet faces, including climate change, pollution, overpopulation, lack of sustainability, and conflicts.

As part of the festival, Steam is featuring post-apocalyptic games, which serve as a grim reminder of what could happen if we don't take action to protect our planet. But Earth Appreciation Festival is not just about doom and gloom. It's also about celebrating the incredible diversity of life on our planet and finding ways to protect it.

That's where Growth comes in. Our game celebrates the beauty of our planet and invites players to become stewards of nature. Growth is the perfect game for anyone who wants to take a break from work or enjoy a relaxed puzzle session. It blends the beauty of cozy exploration with challenging navigation puzzles. We hope that Growth will inspire players to appreciate the beauty of the earth we all call home and are very proud to be part of the Earth Appreciation Festival. 

So, join us on April 17th and let's appreciate Earth together with Growth!

As always, if you want to support a small Indie team, please don’t forget to wishlist Growth on Steam, as this will help us a lot. 


~The Growth Devs
